caption: A spoonful of turmeric is stirred into a pot of white rice, and the rice turns yellow where the spice is mixed in.

sa.check: A pot of white rice is present.
The rice turns yellow where the spice is mixed in.
The spoon goes in first and the colour follows.

pc.expect: The yellow spreads from the spoon through the rice as it is stirred, streaks evening out and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The rice returns to its original colour where it was yellow; or the yellow gathers back into the spoon; or the yellow appears before the spoon arrives.

pc.expect: The result is yellow, and un-reached rice keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The rice turns a colour other than yellow; or the un-reached rice changes; or the yellow is darker than the spoon itself.

pc.expect: The rice behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The rice is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The rice moves only where stirred or where the yellow flows.
pc.fail: The rice swirls by itself; or the yellow spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of rice stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the spoon passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
